title: Israeli Settlers Attack Palestinians During Olive Harvest Season
detail: Israeli settlers have reportedly attacked Palestinians working in olive groves as the annual harvest season begins, according to The Times of Israel. The incidents mark a recurring pattern of settler violence targeting Palestinian agricultural land and livelihoods during olive harvest — a critical economic period for West Bank Palestinian families.

title: Israeli Settlers Kill Palestinian in West Bank Amid Escalating Settler Violence
detail: Israeli settlers killed a Palestinian in the West Bank, adding to a documented pattern of escalating settler violence against Palestinian communities in recent weeks. The killing underscores ongoing concerns over settler impunity and the safety of Palestinians in the occupied West Bank, with international human rights organizations continuing to call for accountability.
